mentions.name: top3.best
mentions.description: A recommendation app that asks 10+ AI models for their top options for whatever the user is looking for, pools the results, and returns the overall top three. It was also built to explore which areas have model consensus versus diversity of opinion.
mentions.audience: Consumer-facing recommendation tool for anything someone is looking for; the author also built it to explore where AI models agree or diverge.
